Why list your restaurant menu online?

When people search “restaurants in Westlands” or “nyama choma near me”, they want to see a menu and prices before they call. A BeautyFlow page answers that in one tap and turns the search into a WhatsApp order or a booking.

  • Your own page at beautyflow.co.ke/restaurant/your-name/ with menu, prices, photos, location and opening hours.
  • Location pages — you appear under “Restaurants in Nairobi”, “Restaurants in Kilimani”, and so on, based on your address.
  • Dish pages — tick what you serve (nyama choma, pilau, pizza, Indian…) and you're listed on those pages too.
  • WhatsApp orders — every dish has an order button; customers can build an order and send it to you in one message.
  • QR-code menu for tables and packaging, printed from your dashboard.

What it costs

The Free plan lists your business with a limited menu and photos. Premium (monthly, paid by M-Pesa) unlocks unlimited menu items and photos, special-offer promotion and top placement. An optional POS module adds order tracking, receipts and sales reports.

How to list your restaurant

  • Create an account with your business name, logo, cover photo and county.
  • Verify your email, add your menu types (breakfast, lunch, drinks…) and dishes with prices — VAT-inclusive or add 16% VAT.
  • Add opening hours, location and WhatsApp number. Your page is live immediately.

Is it really free? Yes — the Free plan has no time limit. Premium is optional and billed monthly.

Do customers need an app? No. Your page works in any browser and orders arrive on your normal WhatsApp.

Can I update prices myself? Yes, anytime from your dashboard; changes are live instantly.
